name: Wit of the Revitalizing Gale
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level: jester 7

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of combat, whenever you receive healing, you may take a 5-foot step as an immediate action.
